hook: Gachibowli commute: IIIT Junction stretch shut *3 more months*
hook_b: Driving past DLF Gate 1? Closure now runs till *late January*
tldr: From Oct 27, the DLF Gate No. 1 to Gachibowli Traffic PS stretch stays shut 3 more months for flyover work.

beats.what: Cyberabad Traffic Police extended the closure by three months from Oct 27.
beats.why: A multi-level flyover is being built at IIIT Junction.
beats.care: Commute via Gachibowli or the IT corridor? Keep using the diversions and add buffer time.

cards.body: Cyberabad Traffic Police have extended the closure of the road between DLF Gate No. 1 and Gachibowli Traffic Police Station by three more months, from Oct 27. The stretch is shut for construction of a multi-level flyover at IIIT Junction. Police say the flyover and related works could continue for at least a year (The Hindu, Hyderabad Mail).

cards.q: How do you get past IIIT Junction now?
By how long was the IIIT Junction road closure extended?
cards.why: Cyberabad Traffic Police extended it by three months from Oct 27; the flyover itself may take a year or more.

steps.e: Flyover works: at least a year, say police

viz.l: more of the DLF Gate 1 – Gachibowli PS closure

learn.t: A multi-level flyover stacks roads at different heights, so traffic in different directions does not meet at a signal.

watch: Whether Cyberabad Traffic Police publish new diversion routes or extend again in January.
